title: Nemesis vs WW (1082767): a Polymarket series event with matching start time exists, but the 05:37Z snapshot still used the Valve model
detail: Read 2026-10-22T07:32Z. Hotspawn fixture 1082767 (Nemesis vs WW, CIS LAN Championship #9) is displayed at 13:30 Europe/Malta = 11:30 UTC. Polymarket Gamma event 1232386 (slug cs2-nem-ww-2026-10-22, title 'Team Nemesis vs WW Team') publishes gameStartTime 2026-10-22 11:30:00+00 and eventStartTime 2026-10-22T11:30:00Z, volume 11812.57, liquidity 21350.56. The alias registry already maps Team Nemesis -> Nemesis and WW Team -> WW inside this competition. The 2026-10-22T05:37:07Z origination snapshot still priced the row from Valve (Nemesis 91.8%). The Polymarket directory at 07:32Z displayed 82¢ / 18¢; that listing is not a validated CLOB midpoint and was not written into any snapshot. Flagged so the next live origination retry is reviewed against the series moneyline books rather than assumed to stay a model.

title: Butterfly vs Lavked (1079651): featured Polymarket books were rejected as wide/crossed; the directory later displayed the opposite side from the Valve pick
detail: The 2026-10-22T05:37Z snapshot prices Butterfly 77.4% from the Valve rating model. The featured collector had already found https://polymarket.com/event/cs2-btf-lavked-2026-10-22 and rejected it ('Crossed or wider-than-12-cent order book'). Gamma event 1232201 confirms gameStartTime 2026-10-22 11:00:00+00 (Hotspawn 13:00 Europe/Malta) and volume 38. At 07:32Z the Polymarket CCT Europe directory displayed Butterfly 43¢ / Lavked 57¢ — the opposite side from Valve. Directory cents are not a CLOB midpoint and were not written into any snapshot. Flagged because a later refresh that accepts a now-two-sided book would change the pick, and because the model currently disagrees with the public listing.

title: HLTV match 2399493 (BakS vs Azuolas) betting module is casino advertising plus a fan vote, not a two-sided bookmaker pair
detail: Read 2026-10-22T07:32Z from https://www.hltv.org/matches/2399493/baks-vs-azuolas-cct-2026-europe-series-12. The match was 28m 18s from start, BO3, CCT 2026 Europe Series 12 Swiss 0-1. The Betting table contained Stake casino creative and 'No promocode available'. The 'Pick a winner' module showed BAKS 84.0% / Azuolas 16.0%; that is an HLTV community vote and is excluded by project policy (same rule as Hotspawn picked_percent). No decimal bookmaker pair was present to originate from. The published pick remains the Valve research estimate (BakS 73.4%) with that limitation on the card. EGamersWorld's 1.8 display next to BakS eSports is recorded as a placeholder, not a two-sided book.

title: K27 vs NEXORA (1082769): Polymarket directory lists a $0-volume market in the same direction as the published EGamersWorld average
detail: The 05:37Z snapshot prices K27 88.8% from the EGamersWorld aggregated bookmaker average (method=reference). At 07:32Z the Polymarket CIS LAN directory listed NEXORA 11¢ / K27 90¢ with a $0 vol label at https://polymarket.com/esports/cs2/cis-lan-championship/cs2-nexora-k271-2026-10-22. Same direction as the published average. Directory cents are not a CLOB midpoint and were not written into any snapshot. Flagged because a zero-volume listing is not evidence the first-party book would pass the spread ceiling.

title: Phone start-here bar listed a 18 Oct Day-5 archive ahead of the current pick index (fixed this session)
detail: scripts/build.py::start_here() previously put 'Day-5 archive (18 Oct)' as the third jump on every phone visit to the executive summary. That is a historical TWC review, not today's Hotspawn card, and on a 390 px screen it pushed Picks at a glance below five navigation cards. Session f60683a4 replaced that item with an in-page jump to #picks-at-a-glance as the first start-here destination, kept the complete-list / unresolved / blanks links, and compacted the bar to a two-column phone grid with the picks jump full-width. The Day-5 archive remains linked from the site map and /final-day/. No probability was changed.
